card.name: Linking words in hyperkalemia drug lists
card.fires_on: The comma, 'potassium', 'with' or 'or' that comes right after a drug class such as potassium-sparing diuretics or diuretics, in warnings about potassium or blood pressure. It marks the spot where the next item in the list is expected.

modes.label: Comma or 'potassium' in list
modes.description: A comma or the word 'potassium' follows 'potassium-sparing diuretics' in a list of agents that raise potassium.
modes.example: concomitant use of potassium-sparing diuretics<<,>> potassium supplements, or salt substitutes containing potassium

modes.label: 'with' after treated
modes.description: The word 'with' follows 'treated' or 'treatment' just before a diuretic or antihypertensive drug class.

card.plain: It fires on the small joining words in lists of drugs that can raise potassium or lower blood pressure, just before the next drug is named.
